subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Navigation and Deep Linking
description: A micro-lesson that makes Navigation and Deep Linking usable.

hook.text: A user taps a notification. Instead of opening the relevant screen, the app opens to the home page.

buildup.text: Deep links open specific screens from URLs, notifications, or other apps. They bypass normal navigation.

discovery.text: Testing deep links covers valid links, expired links, links requiring auth, and links to deleted content.

twist.text: A deep link to a screen that needs login should redirect to login first, then continue to the target.

climax.text: Deep link tests reveal that links to deleted products crash the app. A graceful fallback is added.

punchline.text: Deep links are entry points. Test every one of them independently.

quiz.question: What should a deep link to a deleted resource do?
options: Show a graceful fallback or error message
